prompt: An original 18-second instrumental industrial heavy-metal advertising jingle at 160 BPM in 4/4: fast, upbeat, cocky and triumphant, with palm-muted drop-tuned guitars, a memorable four-note guitar/synth hook repeated throughout, punchy drums with tight double-kick bursts, and controlled distorted synth bass in a clean futuristic stereo mix. Start immediately on a strong downbeat with the hook; keep the middle arrangement spacious and rhythmically steady beneath a deep spoken voice, then let the hook open up for the final four seconds and finish with a crisp resolved two-note sting and short decay. Strictly instrumental: no vocals, speech, chanting, choirs or vocal samples, no long intro, no slow breakdown, no sprawling solo.

creative_direction.user_approved: Fast, upbeat heavy metal instrumental; music begins immediately after spoken So upgrade; announcer narrates upgrade experience; Force Projection cited as energy reference.
creative_direction.assistant_choices: 18 seconds, target 160 BPM, four-note recurring guitar/synth hook, sparse middle for narration, resolved ending.
creative_direction.reference_usage: Descriptive original-music prompt only; no reference song audio supplied, no lyrics requested.

voiceover_reference.timing_basis: Provisional provider-alignment upgrade end; final picture edit not aligned.
